units.source_text: 次日是四月初一更衣节，夕雾右大臣家诸公子都入宫贺节，只有藏人少将闷闷不乐，蛰伏沉思。

en.t: The next day was the first day of the fourth month, the Changing of Robes festival. All the young gentlemen of Yugiri, the Minister of the Right's household, went to court to offer congratulations, but only the Kuroudo no Shosho remained gloomy, shut away in brooding thought.

units.source_text: 母夫人云居雁为他流下同情之泪。

en.t: His mother, Kumoi no Kari, shed tears of sympathy for him.

units.source_text: 右大臣也说：“我怕冷泉上皇不乐，又念玉鬘尚侍不会答应他，

en.t: The Minister of the Right also said, "I feared that Retired Emperor Reizei would be displeased, and I also thought that Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, would not agree to him,

units.source_text: 因此和她会面时不曾提出求婚，真后悔了。

en.t: so when I met with her, I did not bring up the marriage proposal. I truly regret it.

units.source_text: 如果我亲口提出，她岂有不允之理。”

en.t: If I had raised it with her myself, how could she possibly have refused?"

units.source_text: 藏人少将依旧去信诉恨，这回赠诗云：

en.t: The Kuroudo no Shosho still sent letters pouring out his resentment, and this time he added the following poem:
